chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from a man among his companions who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Allah revealed to Moses (peace be upon him): 'My servants do not draw near to Me with anything more beloved to Me than three qualities: detachment from the world, piety from sins, and weeping out of fear of Me.' So Moses said: 'O Lord, what is for the one who does this?' Allah, the Exalted, said: 'As for those who are detached from the world, I will establish them in Paradise; and as for those who eschew sins, I will not call them to account; and as for those who weep out of fear of Me, they shall be in the highest station.'

key_terms.الْبُكَاءُ مِنْ خَشْيَتِي: Weeping out of fear of Me
key_terms.فَمَا أَحَاسِبُهُمْ: I will not make them account

ai.seo_question: What are the three qualities that draw servants closest to Allah according to the hadith of Musa?
ai.summary: This hadith qudsi, recorded in *Kitab al-Zuhd*, emphasizes the triad of spiritual purification through detachment (zuhd), vigilance against sin (wara'), and emotional reverence (buka'). In Shia tradition, these practices are viewed as essential for attaining the 'highest companionship' (al-rafiq al-a'la), often interpreted as proximity to the Prophet and the Imams. The narrative underscores that divine mercy prioritizes internal states of consciousness over mere ritual observance.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 4.Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from a man among his companions who said, “Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) said, ‘Allah revealed to Mūsā (a), “Verily My servants do not approach Me with anything more beloved to Me than three qualities: detachment from the world, eschewal of sins, and weeping out of fear of Me.’” So Mūsā said, “O Lord, what will one who does this get?” Allah, the Exalted, said, “As for those who are detached from the world, I will establish them in Paradise; as for those who eschew sins, I will not make them account [for their deeds]; and as for those who weep out of fear of Me, they shall be in the highest station [in Paradise].”’”
